jobs.title: Project & Corporate Finance Lead
jobs.description:
Job Posting End Date
10-26-2026 Please note the job posting will close on the day before the posting end date.

Job Summary

AEP is seeking a finance leader with practical project finance experience and a strong grounding in corporate finance. The successful candidate will partner with business units, legal, accounting, tax, regulatory and external financing parties to structure and execute financing solutions for major infrastructure and strategic investments. The role’s primary emphasis is project finance, including evaluating bankability, allocating risk, coordinating diligence, developing financing structures and negotiating transaction terms. The position will also support corporate financing, capital structure, credit ratings, cost of capital and regulated utility finance matters.

This is a transaction execution and financial strategy role, not a cash management or treasury operations position. The ideal candidate is energized by complex transactions, cross-functional problem solving and communicating financing recommendations to senior leaders and other stakeholders.
Job Description

What You'll Do:

- Lead the structuring, evaluation and execution of project financings, including non-recourse and limited-recourse structures, construction and term debt, secured facilities, private placements, leases and other fit-for-purpose financing solutions.
- Assess project bankability and financing risk, including commercial terms, construction and completion risk, operating performance, contractual protections, counterparty strength, cash flow durability and lender requirements.
- Coordinate transaction workstreams across internal teams and external advisors, including lenders, investment banks, legal counsel, rating agencies, independent engineers and other diligence providers.
- Develop and review financial models, financing plans, sources-and-uses analyses, debt capacity assessments, sensitivity cases and recommendations that support investment and financing decisions.
- Negotiate financing terms and documentation in partnership with legal counsel and business stakeholders and translate complex provisions into clear business implications for decisionmakers.
- Execute corporate financing transactions, which may include term loans, secured or unsecured bonds, private placements, leases and other capital markets instruments.
- Advise on capital structure, cost of capital, subsidiary financing strategy and credit metrics, including support for rating agency engagement and credit analysis.
- Support financial planning and regulated utility proceedings by preparing analyses, work papers and clear explanations of financing assumptions, cost of debt and cost of capital.
- Prepare concise, decision-oriented materials for executives, the Board of Directors and other stakeholders regarding financing alternatives, transaction status, risks and recommendations.
- Provide leadership, coaching and technical guidance to Corporate Finance team members and promote effective collaboration across the organization.

What We're Looking For:

Treasury Analyst Principal (Salary Grade 9)

Education: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting or related field with solid understanding of financial theory.

Experience: At least 4 years of relevant experience within corporate banking, debt capital markets or corporate finance with direct experience in project finance, infrastructure finance, investment banking, or at least 6 years of adjacent experience that include 1 years of direct experience in project/infrastructure finance.

Treasury Lead (Salary Grade 10)

Education: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting or related field with solid understanding of financial theory.

Experience: At least 6 years of relevant experience within corporate banking, debt capital markets or corporate finance with direct experience in project finance, infrastructure finance, investment banking, or at least 8 years of adjacent experience that include 3 years of direct experience in project/infrastructure finance.

Additional Expectations:

The preferred talent will have
- Meaningful hands-on project finance experience is required. Relevant experience may include power, utilities, renewable energy, transmission, infrastructure or other capital-intensive sectors.
- Working knowledge of project finance structures, credit analysis, financial modeling, due diligence, financing documentation and transaction execution.
- Corporate finance experience involving capital structure, debt financing, credit ratings, cost of capital or financial planning is strongly preferred.

Where You'll Work:
- On-Site in the AEP Headquarters in Columbus, OH

What You'll Get:
- Base salary
- Annual bonus
- 401K match
- AEP Pension
- Comprehensive benefits package that aims to support and enhance the overall well-being of our employees.

jobs.description:

Job Summary

The Procurement Manager, Major Projects, serves as the primary Procurement partner for assigned major transmission capital projects or programs. Embedded within the project team, this senior individual contributor leads procurement integration across materials, equipment, services, construction, supplier capacity, and contracting activities to support successful project delivery.

Working through influence across Procurement, Supply Chain, Engineering, Construction, and Project Controls, the role develops and oversees the integrated procurement plan, anticipates and mitigates risks, aligns procurement activities with project milestones, and provides executive-level visibility into procurement readiness and performance. While not responsible for category strategy, supplier relationship ownership, material tracking, or overall project execution, this position coordinates these capabilities into a unified procurement strategy that supports project success.
Job Description

Where Putting the Customer First Powers Everything We Do!

What You'll Do:

- Serve as the primary procurement liaison and single point of coordination for assigned major projects, partnering closely with Project Managers, Project Directors, and project leadership.
- Develop, maintain, and drive the integrated project procurement plan, ensuring alignment with engineering, construction, commissioning, and project milestones.
- Translate project schedules and business objectives into coordinated procurement, sourcing, contracting, supplier, and material execution plans.
- Represent project material and capacity requirements within the Transmission COE portfolio planning process and incorporate prioritization decisions into project execution plans.
- Maintain procurement dashboards and risk registers that provide visibility into milestones, supplier capacity, material status, commercial issues, actions, decisions, and executive reporting.
- Coordinate cross-functional execution across Transmission COE, Category Management, PPO, Sourcing, Contracts, Engineering, Project Controls, Construction, Logistics, and other stakeholders.
- Establish clear accountability, decision paths, and escalation processes to resolve procurement issues and risks.
- Partner with Procurement teams to address supplier performance, capacity constraints, category strategies, and commercial considerations.
- Communicate procurement readiness, key risks, mitigation plans, and critical decisions to project leadership.
- Leverage analytics, systems, and continuous improvement practices to enhance sourcing effectiveness, contract visibility, supplier performance, and project outcomes.

What We're Looking For:

Education/Experience:

- Bachelor's degree in a related field and 8 years of relevant experience.
- Associate's degree in a related field and 10 years of relevant experience; or
- High School Diploma/GED and 12 years of relevant experience.
- Demonstrated success leading complex cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
- Strong knowledge of procurement processes, contracting, supplier management, supply markets, manufacturing lead times, and delivery assurance.
- Experience supporting large capital, utility, energy, transmission, infrastructure, industrial, or engineering projects.
- Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and executive communication skills.

- Knowledge of project controls, critical path scheduling, commissioning, and construction sequencing.

jobs.description:

Job Summary

The Procurement Category Manager will act as Lead for assigned Procurement projects, programs, and sourcing categories. Main responsibly is to oversee the specific projects and sourcing categories by providing leadership to team members in a variety of strategic areas including sourcing, procurement, contracts, supplier relationship management, supplier development, and strategy development and execution. This position will have responsibility for achieving annual savings targets from $5 million to $20 million and manage categories with an annual spend in the from $100 million to $700 million for materials and services.

To be successful, this individual requires highly advanced level of knowledge and responsibility for developing, negotiating, executing and maintaining strategic sourcing agreements for specific categories for the procurement of materials, equipment and/or services used by AEP internal customers. The Procurement Category Manager will identify cost reduction opportunities and capture real Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) savings (direct or indirect) by aggregating sourcing volumes.
Job Description

What You'll Do:

- Manage project-driven sourcing activities for a variety of market baskets that are normally associated with high-spend, high-impact, and often complex categories across multiple business unit stakeholders.
- Develop and implement strategies to achieve corporate savings goals.
- Establish effective relationships and work collaboratively with Business Unit customers and suppliers to maintain customer satisfaction.
- Interface with Business Unit leadership to report ongoing progress to goals.
- Champion new initiatives that will support shared business objectives, support the business unit partner's needs, and enable the company to efficiently operate in a competitive and changing environment.

What We're Looking For:

Education requirements are listed below:
- Bachelors Degree in Business Administration or related field of study.
- MBA or Purchasing certification is preferred but not required.

Work Experience requirement listed below:
- 6+ years supply chain experience.
- Advanced negotiations and ability to execute complex business transactions.

Other Must Haves:

- Must have strong analytical, teamwork and communication skills.
- Must have ability to effectively work with all levels of internal management and external suppliers and must be able to prioritize and coordinate activities to successfully perform in this position.
- Previous experience leading employees/teams preferred.
- Expert knowledge of supply base, including market economics, supply base cost structure, supply base trends, supplier segmentation.
- Expert knowledge of the market forces shaping customer’s business context.
- Ability to conduct independent market intelligence and leverage personal network.
- Demonstrated experience in identifying and utilizing full set of supply levers to drive category performance, including the development of complex collaboration partnership with suppliers.
- Ability to conduct benchmarking and measure category performance along all dimensions of cost, quality, risk, innovation and operating processes
- Ability to provide thought leadership to customers and actively shape customer’s overall strategy through sourcing lens.
- Expert Analytical & Technical negotiation skills.
- Ability to use automated technology systems to inform category strategies & SRM activities.
- Experience using e-procurement tools.
- Ability to quantify financial benefits for identified set of opportunities and initiatives.
- Experience at developing complex cost and financial models.
- Highly proficient with Excel and MS Office Suite.
- Ability to draw strategic insight from analysis, and to effectively summarize and present insight based on the needs of the audience.
- Experience with Ariba suite of tools is a plus Change Management & Relationship Management.
